title: Fix 267
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-records-006 already refuses a GitHub, GitLab, Slack, AWS or model-provider token form in every value Chough writes; only the matcher and its tests change.
acceptance_criteria: A token form that directly follows a hyphen, such as x-ghp_<token> in a checkpoint question, a session key or a raw log name, refuses the write as refused:leak naming the field and the kind token, with every file unchanged; chough doctor reports the same text in a committed record as a leak finding. The same token after a space, colon or dot is still refused.
